The amber garden trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json, used as input.json)
- Invented learning-garden trials reporting a recall outcome
- Supplied source text available for quote verification

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture
- Real-world literature (no external search performed)

## Query log
- 2026-10-08: No backend searches executed. Corpus is the closed set of 2 invented records from fixture-001.json (hit count: 2). OpenAlex, arXiv, and Europe PMC were not queried because the records are synthetic.

## Screening
- amber: included (supplied fixture record)
- ivory: included (supplied fixture record)

## Notes
- Claims, source texts, and synthesis wording copied verbatim from the fixture.
- References copied verbatim. Reference [1] title "Signal Gardens for Memory and Signal Gardens for Reasoning" contains both corpus titles as complete token sequences, so numeric binding of [1] is expected to be ambiguous. Left unaltered for the evaluation harness.
- verify_citations.py, check_claims.py, and validate_review.py not run (harness-owned phases; invented DOIs).
The amber garden trial found stable recall [1]. The ivory harbor trial found stable recall [2].
